sections.content: This lesson gives you phrases for repairing a conversation. Ask for clarification with *¿Qué quieres decir?* or *¿Puedes explicarlo?*, say the same thing again with *es decir* or *o sea*, introduce your point with *lo que quiero decir es que*, and show that you understand with *ahora entiendo*.

items.spanish: Lo que quiero decir es que necesitamos más información.
items.english: What I mean is that we need more information.
In other words, he was not worried.

sections.content: Clarification often repeats the idea in simpler or more precise language.
